title: Fix ApproveAsync crash window (file-changed-before-status)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG1-03 / F54 (memorysmith-approveasync-audit-26-07-19-01-19-01)

## Problem
`ApproveAsync` calls `_store.ApplyAsync` (writes actual file) BEFORE persisting the proposal's own status change. If the process crashes between the two, the file is changed but the proposal record is stuck at pre-approval status. An idempotency guard in `ApplyAsync` prevents double-application but produces an opaque `InvalidOperationException` on retry.

## Severity
Medium

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` lines 716-725
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/FileMaintenanceProposalStore.cs` lines 617-646

## Recommendation
Invert order (persist status first, roll back on failure) or add intermediate `Applying` status with deterministic recovery logic.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.

comments.body: Audit synthesis corroboration: the redacted delta audit identifies a crash window where a file-backed mutation can remove or replace content before status persistence completes. This is adjacent to the broader atomic-persistence task; retain this record for the approve-specific recovery path.
